notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: the R2 hardware backend is refused until reviewed_by is set, and nothing ran on an arm. The gate raises no warning (G4 reads the SDK's 2 * math.pi and math.pi as numbers). Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests; the motion classes have no speed or acceleration field, so moves run at the SDK's last used speed. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): SAFE-042 correction; still PASS. The @reset hook ran clean_error and clean_warn and then motion_enable(True), set_mode(0) and set_state(0), so a safety reset re-armed this R2 arm, which SAFE-042 forbids and earlier reviews missed. The hook is removed: a reset only releases the latch and sends the arm nothing. The whole recovery the SDK documents is now the declared re-enable x-cap.xarm-developer.enable_motion.v1 (reenable=True, CORE-086; MHS/changes/RE-ENABLE-AND-TERMINAL-STOP.md): clean_error and clean_warn (xarm_api.py:1588-1604), then motion_enable(True), set_mode(0) and set_state(0), which clean_error says must follow by hand (xarm_api.py:1590) and which the upstream examples start with (example/wrapper/xarm7/2001-move_joint.py:44-46); the first non-zero code stops it. It is refused while latched, takes no input and is named in the reset receipt; TSAFE-001 sends it after the reset and before its recovery move. The SDK now refuses an @reset hook beside a re-enable. Three Facts added; 22 package cases pass (the reset sends nothing, the re-enable is refused while latched with nothing sent, the re-enable then a move completes, a failing clean_error enables nothing). The sentence above that no catalogue request exists is superseded: the new extension is listed in catalogue_requests. G1-G9 pass with no finding. The gate digest is unchanged: it identifies the gate's findings (none before or after), not the package content. setup() still runs the start sequence once when the backend is first opened; that is not a reset. Changed driver.py, facts.md, README.md, test_driver.py, reference.json, REFERENCE.md, RESULT.json, check-report.json. Source pin, authorship (claude-sonnet-5-5) and driver.lock.json unchanged. No arm or human review.

catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class re-enables a stopped arm after a safety reset (the declared re-enable, CORE-086): clear its errors and warnings, enable motion, select position mode and the motion state. The cap.motion classes command or stop motion. The extension takes no input and returns whether all five SDK calls returned API code 0.
catalogue_requests.summary: Re-enable the arm after a safety reset: clean_error, clean_warn, motion_enable(True), set_mode(0), set_state(0).
